wing_missile.speaker: VIPER 2
wing_missile.text: You've got a missile on your six, break right!

wing_hit.speaker: VIPER 2
wing_hit.text: Viper One, you're hit! Shake it off!

awacs_damage.speaker: OVERWATCH
awacs_damage.text: Viper One, you're taking heavy damage. Watch yourself.

awacs_good.speaker: OVERWATCH
awacs_good.text: Target destroyed. Keep it up, Viper One.

lso_vtol.speaker: PADDLES
lso_vtol.text: Nice and gentle. Viper One is on deck.

lso_bolter.speaker: PADDLES
lso_bolter.text: Bolter, bolter! Power up and go around!

lso_ball.speaker: PADDLES
lso_ball.text: Viper One, call the ball. Follow the meatball, keep it centered.

lso_vtol_hint.speaker: PADDLES
lso_vtol_hint.text: Hold brake to transition to hover, then settle onto the deck.

instr_welcome.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_welcome.text: Welcome to basic flight training, Viper One. Hold your phone upright, like a steering wheel.

instr_turn.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_turn.text: Tilt the phone left or right to bank and turn. Fly through the gates.

instr_pitch.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_pitch.text: Lean the top of the phone to pitch up or down. Climb through the high gate, then dive through the low one.

instr_boost.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_boost.text: Hold boost for afterburner. Brake to slow down. Speed is life, but don't let her stall.

instr_gun.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_gun.text: Target drones ahead. Get close, put the circle on them, and hold the gun button.

instr_msl.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_msl.text: Now missiles. Keep a target in front of you until the diamond turns red, then tap missile.

instr_tgt.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_tgt.text: Tap target to switch between targets. Tap S P for your special weapon. It can lock several targets at once.

instr_done.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
instr_done.text: Outstanding flying. You're cleared for combat operations, Viper One.

tower_cat.speaker: ACED CONTROL
tower_cat.text: Viper One, you're hooked up on cat one. Hold boost to launch.

m1_start.speaker: OVERWATCH
m1_start.text: Overwatch to Viper One. Four bandits and two bombers inbound from the north. Protect the carrier at all costs.

m1_bombers.speaker: OVERWATCH
m1_bombers.text: Priority targets are the bombers. Don't let them reach the fleet.

m1_wave2.speaker: OVERWATCH
m1_wave2.text: More contacts on radar. Second wave, bearing three five zero.

m1_rtb.speaker: OVERWATCH
m1_rtb.text: Airspace is clear. Viper One, return to mother. You're cleared to land.

m1_carrier_hit.speaker: ACED CONTROL
m1_carrier_hit.text: We've been hit! The carrier is taking damage!

wing_join.speaker: VIPER 2
wing_join.text: Viper Two, on your wing. Let's dance.

m2_start.speaker: OVERWATCH
m2_start.text: Viper One, enemy fighters are hiding in the cloud layer. Clear the sky.

m2_wave2.speaker: OVERWATCH
m2_wave2.text: Second squadron climbing out of the clouds. Engage.

m2_wave3.speaker: OVERWATCH
m2_wave3.text: Watch it, these two are flying differently. Aces.

m2_end.speaker: OVERWATCH
m2_end.text: That's the last of them. Outstanding work up here, Viper One.

wing_clouds.speaker: VIPER 2
wing_clouds.text: I can't see a thing in these clouds!

m3_start.speaker: RAPTOR 1
m3_start.text: Spirit, this is Raptor One. We'll keep the fighters off you. Put steel on those ships.

m3_fleet.speaker: OVERWATCH
m3_fleet.text: Enemy fleet in range. Five destroyers. Drop when ready.

m3_flares.speaker: OVERWATCH
m3_flares.text: Spirit, use your flares against incoming missiles.

m3_end.speaker: OVERWATCH
m3_end.text: Fleet neutralized. Spirit, turn for home. Good hunting.

m4_start.speaker: OVERWATCH
m4_start.text: Viper One, enemy surface group to the east, with air cover. Guided bombs are cleared hot.

m4_mid.speaker: OVERWATCH
m4_mid.text: Half the fleet is burning. Keep pressing.

m4_end.speaker: OVERWATCH
m4_end.text: Surface group destroyed. Nice work, Viper One.

m5_start.speaker: OVERWATCH
m5_start.text: Raid incoming! Six bombers with fighter escort, heading straight for the carrier.

m5_mid.speaker: ACED CONTROL
m5_mid.text: Bombers closing on the fleet. Stop them, Viper!

m5_land.speaker: OVERWATCH
m5_land.text: Raid repelled. Viper One, bring your Lightning home. Vertical landing approved.

m6_start.speaker: OVERWATCH
m6_start.text: Viper One, four contacts above the clouds. Red tails. It's the Crimson squadron.

m6_crimson1.speaker: CRIMSON 1
m6_crimson1.text: So you're the one they call Viper. Let's see if you live up to it.

m6_crimson2.speaker: CRIMSON 1
m6_crimson2.text: Not bad. Crimson flight, break and attack!

m6_lead.speaker: OVERWATCH
m6_lead.text: Only the leader remains. Take him down, Viper One!

m6_end.speaker: OVERWATCH
m6_end.text: Crimson One is down! Viper One, you are the ace of aces.

bandit_2.speaker: BANDIT
bandit_2.text: He's on my tail! Get him off me!

brief_m0.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m0.text: Basic training. Learn to fly, to shoot, and to lock missiles. Live fire drones only. Nobody shoots back.

brief_m1.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m1.text: Dawn patrol off the coast. Launch from the carrier, intercept an enemy strike package, and land back on deck.

brief_m2.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m2.text: Enemy fighters are operating above a solid cloud deck. Climb, find them, and clear the sky.

brief_m3.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m3.text: Take the B-2 Spirit deep into enemy waters. Raptors will escort you. Destroy the enemy fleet.

brief_m4.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m4.text: An enemy surface group is shelling the coast. Use guided bombs to sink every ship.

brief_m5.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m5.text: Bombers are heading for our carrier. Launch, intercept, and bring your F-35B back with a vertical landing.

brief_m6.speaker: BRIEFING
brief_m6.text: The Crimson squadron. The best they have. Four aces, one sky. Only one of you comes home.
